dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #Welcome home, {NICKNAME}, it's great to have you back.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Um, I heard that I should say these sorts of things whenever family returns home.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: To be honest, I had originally expected this place to be like an adeptus's abode...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I never suspected that your design would differ so greatly from what I had imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If you had to pick, would you prefer an adeptus's abode or here?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Hmm, most adepti spend their years wandering the outside world. Though their abodes can be uniquely picturesque, they also feel like a lonely and remote paradise.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: But here feels very warm and cozy, and I have a nice person like you to keep me company. I've truly never experienced anything like this.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: What I mean is... I like it here. I will cherish this place and learn to adapt to life here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, that's good to hear.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: However... there are many pieces of decoration and furniture here that I've never seen before. I'm uncertain of their use or purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: So please take a moment to explain everything to me when you could spare the time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Chat? Then I suppose you must enjoy chatting, just like my master.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Alright then, aside from my rigorous training in the adepti arts, my master also taught me the skills of conversation. Though more often than not, she was the only one speaking and I ended up just listening quietly.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I suppose I should take the opportunity to practice whenever it presents itself. Why don't you start?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you learned about making conversation?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Well... It seems that conversation is a skill that can't be practiced like other arts. There isn't any concrete methodology to mastering it as far as I can tell.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I only remember my master saying that the purpose of talking is not only to convey information, but also to direct the mood and deepen mutual feelings.

choices.text: How do you direct the mood?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Well, according to her, you should pick topics of interest to your partner. That's the best way to direct the mood of the conversation.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Before I met you, I wasn't close with anyone. There were barely any topics that would ever spark my interest.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Well, whenever my master brought you up as the topic, I'll admit I felt quite... amused.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Me?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Yes, you. She said that you are widely regarded as a bold and fearless hero, but if people had seen the look of sheer panic on your face when you fell from the first Jade Chamber...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ah yeah, about that...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: You're blushing. Is this how it feels when the mood of a conversation begins to shift?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: It seems my master's conversation techniques are quite handy after all...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I've got it, I shall go ask my master all about you. That way, we'll have many more common topics to discuss.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No, uh, please don't do that...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Oh, I suppose there's no need to go through all that trouble, you're already sitting right here in front of me after all.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: In which case, please, tell me more about yourself. I'll remember everything you say!

choices.text: You don't seem like you enjoy chatting at all...
How do you deepen mutual feelings?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I'm quite ashamed, actually, I have no talent for this and my master's expertise hasn't rubbed off on me at all...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: The feelings shared between my adepti teachers and me are quite extraordinary. We don't need to converse to deepen our feelings for each other.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: And besides them, I have no real friends, which means that I've never had someone with whom to deepen my feelings.

choices.text: You don't seem like you enjoy chatting at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact, I would like something to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, you're hungry?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Well, no. Not really. I actually just wanted to sit and chat with you over a long meal.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I heard that sharing a meal is really important to the people of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It's not only about eating, but rather, "sharing an enjoyable time with those that are important to you."

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: When everyone gathers together over a meal, that's called a "get-together," right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's right, especially during the holidays.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Like Lantern Rite? I know that everyone is supposed to release Xiao Lanterns during that holiday... a pity that it's only once a year.

choices.text: There are other holidays, too, you know...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I used to always feel that the holidays had nothing to do with me. But now... there seems to be a longing in my heart for the next holiday to come more quickly.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I would like to use all that I have learned to celebrate together with you.

choices.text: I almost didn't realize it, but...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I've been growing thanks to your constant guidance. Believe me, I won't forget your kindness.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: And my feelings toward you are not only of gratitude...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: But anyway, let's celebrate the next holiday together!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We'll have a get-together?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Yes, a big get-together.

choices.text: For example, the Moonchase Festival. Everyone gathers to enjoy the moonlight together.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Shenhe.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #Oh, up already, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If those noisy birds woke you up, I'll go silence them right away.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, you don't want me to harm them? Fine... I'll just shoo them away. Don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Shenhe.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}, have a nice rest.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If you find yourself tossing and turning, I have some herbs to calm the spirit and help you sleep. Just let me know if you need them.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Even if it's late, I promise it won't be trouble for me at all. So please don't hesitate.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I much prefer tranquil places like this to the constant clamor of the city.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It's somewhere that I can be myself. No distractions.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: A life of freedom, leisure, and relative privacy... It seems this appeals to you, too.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If we were in Liyue Harbor, this street would be crammed with people... and I don't think I'd stay longer than I needed to.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: But here, this street seems like such a safe place...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Join me for a walk. It could be good practice for you, helping me acclimatize to the mortal world.
